name: HubSpot Breeze
summary: HubSpot's AI: agents and assistants built into the CRM.
description: Breeze bundles HubSpot's AI features: an assistant that writes and summarizes inside the CRM, agents for content, prospecting and customer service, and automatic enrichment of contact and company data.

howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.
